items.title: Theresa May 'aghast' at Burnham's EU plans and says 'Brexit is done'
items.summary: "Just accept Brexit and move on," the former prime minister tells BBC's Laura Kuenssberg.

items.title: Boss of British Gas owner Centrica 'hugely concerned' over impact of soaring energy bills
items.summary: Chris O'Shea says the number of people unable or unwilling to pay their energy bills will increase when prices jump in the new year.

items.title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
items.summary: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.

items.title: RAF's next fighter jet could be last crewed combat plane, air chief says
items.summary: The head of the RAF said AI-enabled and uncrewed aircrafts are expected to start flying in UK airspace next year.

items.title: Russell Brand's wife says she'll honour prison rules after message row
items.summary: The wife of the disgraced comedian says she will stick to the "parameters", after reading out a message from her inmate husband.

items.title: BBC apologises after noise disruption during Strictly
items.summary: Strictly Come Dancing judge Motsi Mabuse was giving feedback to Delta Goodrem when she paused after the sound started playing.

items.title: How a teen gamer and his mother helped rescue a missing girl
items.summary: When 16-year-old Landon Tresp met a teenage girl in an online game, it led to him and his mother helping the FBI rescue her from kidnapping.

items.title: Russia-bound ship still on fire after attack in Gulf of Finland
items.summary: Finnish defence forces say that Ukraine was likely behind the drone attack on the vessel.
